name: Crest of the Blue Ridge Henderson County

known.article: Crest of the Blue Ridge Henderson County AVA
known.via: English Wikipedia "Crest of the Blue Ridge Henderson County AVA"

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A North Carolina AVA. Its distinguishing features are its climate and topography, above all its elevation.
